newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bunds make minor spread gains, BTP/Bund gap steady.
newsitem.headline: Bunds make minor spread gains, BTP/Bund gap steady.

text.p: 1515 GMT - Bunds end the day ahead of T-notes. U.S. June housing starts rose 4.8 percent to 1.452 million unit annual rate. Jobless claims fell to 349,000 in July 12 week from 377,000 prev. Phil Fed survey of business conditions rose to 28.1 from June's 25.2. Gilts surrender four b.p. spread gain to Bunds. OATs inch closer to Bunds but unchanged from earlier. BTP/Bund gap returns to steady after small narrowing.
Government bond spreads are calculated from Reuter benchmark bond price data and adjusted to take into account interest payment frequency.
